title: Clip The Other Side of Hard with Ken Rideout
description: Clip full episodes of The Other Side of Hard, Ken Rideout's podcast. $1 per 1,000 views on TikTok, Reels and Shorts, $10 to $100 per clip. Ken is a world champion marathoner and recovered addict who talks to Olympians, NBA players and fighters about the hardest thing they got through.
guidelines:
MUST HAVE: "The Other Side of Hard with Ken Rideout" on screen for the full clip. Clips without it are rejected
MUST BE 25 to 60 seconds. Shorter or longer clips are rejected
Clip only from the two linked full episodes: Shawn Johnson East and Chris Herren
Open on a confession, a hard number or a strong claim in the first 3 seconds
One complete story per clip with a clear ending
9:16 vertical, burned-in captions, original audio
Caption must tag @ken_rideout and name the guest
Do not clip ad reads or mention sponsors
Do not clip anything about Larry Nassar or USA Gymnastics team doctors
Captions and titles must match what the speaker said. No fake quotes or invented drama
Do not present drug use as fun or cool. Chris Herren clips must read as a recovery story
No health or medical claims
No AI voices, reaction overlays, gameplay split screens or copyrighted music
No bought views or bots. Flagged clips are rejected
